parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance for which you want to update the name.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The new name of the instance. No limits are imposed on the value. We recommend that you set this parameter to a maximum of 64 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun amqp-open update-instance-name --instance-id amqp-cn-zvp2ajsj0000 --instance-name amqp_test --region cn-hangzhou
